goal: Explore this bookshop like a careful first-time buyer: browse the catalog, add books to the cart, change quantities, remove one, check out, then visit the account, orders, and sign-in pages. Report every defect you have evidence of.

runs.summary: Explored the catalog, cart quantity/removal controls, checkout, orders, account profile, and sign-in flow, including a completed purchase with fake data. Evidence shows negative inventory for Neuromancer, a misspelled Help link, missing cart count, stale/incorrect cart totals after quantity changes, implausible 1970 order-confirmation dates, an orders-count/list mismatch, and profile saves that lose the edited display name. The primary purchase flow succeeds, but these defects make inventory, navigation, cart totals, order history, and profile persistence unreliable.

runs.summary: Explored all primary user flows of the Bookshelf web application, including catalog browsing, cart management, checkout, account settings, order history, and sign-in pages. Discovered multiple defects including broken cart total calculations, incorrect item removal from the cart, broken 'Add to cart' functionality for specific books, unrendered UI template tokens, order date formatting bugs, and broken navigation links. While basic page routing works, core e-commerce features suffer from severe functional and data integrity defects.

runs.summary: Explored the Bookshelf bookshop across all major flows: browsed catalog (4 books), added items to cart, manipulated quantities and removed items, completed checkout with order placement, and visited Orders, Account, and Sign-in pages. Identified 8 distinct defects: (1) Neuromancer shows negative inventory (-3), (2–5) cart total calculations persistently incorrect across multiple states ($14.00, $25.25, $53.25 shown instead of correct amounts), (6) cart quantity unexpectedly changed to 5 for Hyperion, (7) wrong item removed from cart (Hyperion disappeared when Solaris was removed), and (8) order confirmation displayed invalid epoch timestamp (1970-01-01) with impossible delivery date (1969-12-29). All core user flows have been exercised as chartered. The application is functionally navigable but has critical calculation and state management bugs in cart operations and order processing.
